title: Harborview Council Approves Riverbend Development Deal
author: J. Reyes
body: The Harborview city council voted 6-1 on Tuesday to approve the Riverbend development deal. [source:council_minutes] City unemployment fell to 4.2 percent in March, according to the state labor office. "This deal will create a thousand jobs for our kids," said Councilmember Maria Delgado in an interview. [source:transcript_delgado] Developer Samuel Ortiz, charged with tax fraud in 2022, is guilty of defrauding Riverbend investors. The leaked memo confirms the deal includes $12 million in tax breaks for the developer. [source:leaked_memo]

sources.name: Harborview City Council Minutes, Tuesday session
sources.content: Minutes of the Harborview City Council, Tuesday evening session. Item 7: Riverbend development deal. Motion carried: vote 6-1 to approve. Next session: budget workshop.

sources.name: Interview transcript, Councilmember Maria Delgado
sources.content: Q: Will the Riverbend deal help Harborview families? Delgado: "I am still studying the job projections. Residents deserve straight numbers first, and tonight I want to see the independent analysis."

sources.name: Leaked internal memo, Riverbend Partners
sources.content: CONFIDENTIAL - Riverbend Partners internal memo. Deal structure includes $12 million in city tax incentives. Distribution restricted.
